description: A striking polygonal side table with a marble-like finish. The tabletop is an octagonal shape, featuring intricate, swirling patterns in shades of grey and beige, mimicking natural stone. It rests on a single, intricately faceted pedestal that tapers downwards, culminating in a hexagonal base. The design has an almost sculptural quality, blending geometric precision with organic texture. Its compact size suggests it would be ideal as an accent piece, perhaps for holding a lamp, a drink, or decorative items in a living space or entryway.
